test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A square table was surrounded by eight chairs, four of them were at the corners of the table while four others were exactly in the middle of the sides of the table. Six clerks D, E, F, G, H and I were seated around this square table facing the centre of the table. The chairs at two corners of the table were vacant. E and I were seated at the corners diagonally opposite to each other. H was second to the left of G. D was second to the right of F. G was seated right and immediate next to E. Who among the following was facing H?
solution: Given:A square table was surrounded by eight chairs, Six clerks D, E, F, G, H and I were seated around this square table facing the centre of the table. 1) The chairs at two corners of the table were vacant. 2) E and I were seated at the corners diagonally opposite to each other.
